title: Pale Improvments
description: A simple mod that tries to improve pale gardens.
body:
This mod tries to expand upon the pale garden in minecraft by adding new stuff to make it more intresting such as a new structure and pumpkins to make it feel more like a garden and more alive while still trying to keep the dead vibe of the biome. 

**Fetures include a pale pumkin set, a new pale, ruined house with more to explore inside of this wonderfull biome.** 

Hope you all enyoy! And if you want to you can include this in your modpack and feture it in videos without giving credit. I just hope you have a fun time with this!

> Made with mcreator.
